Results.ReviewText: I loved my first Weber grill. I would recommend them to my friends and family. I thought I would give Weber one last try and purchased the Spirit E-310, this grill will be the last Weber grill I will purchase. The quality is extremely poor compared to previous models I have own. I feel its a low end grill with a large price tag. Not sure if its because they are made outside the USA or Weber has no pride in quality. Hopefully Weber will have better pride in quality, but the trend has been going away from that.

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear that your grill was damaged and that you have not been able to get in touch with our Support team. We just sent you an email to follow-up on your issues.

Regarding the black material you see is a natural result of grilling and should be cleaned.

As you use your grill, vapors and grease from the grilling process can build up and create a deposit on the inside of your grill lid.

The high heat of the grill will cause the deposit to harden, and it will begin to flake or peel off.
 
This peeling or flaking substance will be paper-thin, black, and glossy on one side and matte on the other, and is known as carbonized grease.

We apologize for the inconvenience and we look forward to helping you soon. Thanks!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.Title: Weber is The Best

Results.ReviewText: Purchased the Weber E-310 in August 2017 with the Weber cover. I use it twice a week and it is covered after cooling when not in use. The grill grates were rusted and chipping and the burners got rusted through after the third burner stopped igniting. The bolts holding the burner securely in place were also rusted so I couldn't remove the burners. Being only 4 years old, maybe it's because of the humidity in South Florida.  I worked with the warranty department but was nervous I would be out of luck. Gotta say Weber definitely stands 100% behind their product.  There is a reason Weber is well known and a top quality grill. Originally had my overall rating at 3 stars due to the rust after only 4 years but changed to a 5 star solely based on the warranty and Weber standing up to the warranty and standing behind their product.  I will definitely continue to buy Weber grills after the E-310 has had its last day.
Results.Title: Great Warranty

Results.ReviewText: We an into a problem with our grates a little over a year after having purchased our grill, and Weber replaced the parts in such an easy manner. Great customer service!

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
